tenderSchedule.title: TENDERS FOR THE FLOATER GROUP MEDICLAIM SCHEME TO THE EMPLOYEES OF THE BOARD FOR A PERIOD OF 1 YEAR FROM 16/11/2026 TO 15/11/2027
tenderSchedule.description: TENDERS FOR THE FLOATER GROUP MEDICLAIM SCHEME TO THE EMPLOYEES OF THE BOARD FOR A PERIOD OF 1 YEAR FROM 16/11/2026 TO 15/11/2027

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and conditions as per tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer should be a either Proprietorship or Partnership Firm or Private Limited Company or Public Limited Company. Furnish the copy of Certificate incorporation or Partnership deed or registration copy with the appropriate authorities in support of the name of Organisation.
Government Insurance Company & Private Insurance Companies participating in the tender should be governed by IRDA guidelines
The tenderer shall furnish a list of 3 clients with their address and a proof of work order along with agreement copy entered with them.
The tenderer shall furnish undertaking on the letter head of the Insurance companies.
The tenderer shall meet the requirements as mentioned in scheduled of requirement (Section-V).
Each and every page of the tender document , submitted/uploaded in e-procurement portal shall be serially numbered and signed by the authorized signatory of the concerned.
The tenderer should produce the copy of Permanent Account Number (PAN) issued by the Income Tax Authorities
The average annual turnover of the company should be Rs.2 cores or more of the last 3 financial years. Furnish a copy of a turn over certificate

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer shall submit the copy of Income Tax return filed with the Income Tax authorities for the last financial year
The tenderer shall submit the copy of GST Registration Certificate along with the last year annual returns filed to the authority concerned.
